svg.title: The newest documents on the dashboard
svg.desc: The dashboard of jamie asks the widget New in Paperless for its items. The app takes the 25 documents that Paperless-ngx added last from Nextcloud's distributed cache, or else asks Paperless for them, newest first, and keeps them for a minute for every user, since every request carries the token of the settings. Of these, jamie sees the documents whose file of the archive account jamie can open, found by their markers in one search of the file cache, at most seven, with the names of their correspondents, types and tags. Each item shows the preview of its file, its title, and the day that Paperless added it, its correspondent, its type and up to two of its tags, such as Sep 3, 2026 · Example Motors · Receipt · warranty, and opens the file in Files.
